result.stdout:
USAGE:
    t2i <prompt> [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

ARGUMENTS:
    <prompt>    The text prompt describing the image to generate

OPTIONS:
                      DEFAULT                                                 
    -h, --help                   Prints help information                      
        --provider               Provider to use (foundry-flux2, foundry-mai2)
    -o, --out                    Output file path (default: output.png)       
    -w, --width       512        Image width in pixels (default: 512)         
        --height      512        Image height in pixels (default: 512)        
    -s, --steps       20         Number of inference steps (default: 20)      
        --endpoint               Cloud provider endpoint (override config)    
        --api-key                Cloud provider API key (override secrets)    
        --timeout     300        Request timeout in seconds (default: 300)    

COMMANDS:
    config              Manage configuration                                    
    secrets <action>    Manage provider secrets                                 
    doctor              Run diagnostics on providers and configuration          
    providers           List available providers and their status               
    version             Display version information                             
    update              Check for and install binary updates to the t2i tool    
    init                Initialize the current folder with a t2i skill file for 
                        AI coding agents                                        
    upgrade             Refresh existing t2i skill files without creating new   
                        files

DESCRIPTION:
Manage configuration

USAGE:
    t2i config [action] [key] [value] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    t2i config show
    t2i config set foundry-flux2.endpoint https://...
    t2i config path

ARGUMENTS:
    [action]    Action: show, set, set-all, remove, path   
    [key]       Configuration key (e.g., provider.endpoint)
    [value]     Configuration value                        

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

DESCRIPTION:
Initialize the current folder with a t2i skill file for AI coding agents

USAGE:
    t2i init [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    t2i init
    t2i init --target github
    t2i init --keep-existing

OPTIONS:
                             DEFAULT                                            
    -h, --help                          Prints help information                 
        --target <TARGET>    all        Target platform(s): github, claude, or  
                                        all (default: all)                      
        --keep-existing                 Skip files that already exist (default: 
                                        update existing files)
